title: Replay rows carry the served, withheld and violated records of each arm C session
body:
Source: S8 readiness audit 2026-11-19 (lead session); ADR 0021 points 10-11.
Evidence: evals/replay/rows.ts:1-60 has no exposure fields; exposure writes live only in src/hook/stop.ts, src/hook/edit-standards.ts and src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts; evals/replay/arm-session.ts writes none.
Outcome: every arm C row (and arm B's static set) lists served, withheld and violated record ids from the session's exposure log, so per-record effect (ADR 0021 point 11 claim 3) is computed from replay rows; the report prints per-record served/violated counts and pass-rate delta.
Proof: a replay test with a fixture session exposure log yields a row whose served/withheld/violated match it, and --report prints the per-record table.
